description: Vehicle fleet, emissions, fuel consumption and modal split is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by GIZ. The dataset supports policy development, climate impact assessment, and transport planning for Kenya’s transition towards low-carbon mobility. Data sources include HBEFA 3.3, national reports, and GIZ/INFRAS research. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher GIZ. Its tags are transport emissions, vehicle fleet. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-02-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
